title: You're seeing the past
caption: Starlight is old news: you see every star as it was when its light left.

beats.head: Every star you see is a *memory*.
beats.sub: You see light that left it long ago.

beats.head: Sunlight takes about *eight minutes* to reach you.
beats.sub: So you always see the Sun as it was.

beats.head: The brightest star at night? Light from almost *nine* years ago.

vis.note: Sirius, the brightest star at night

beats.head: Some stars you can see sent their light *centuries* ago.
All that way, just to land in *your* eyes.
beats.sub: The least you can do is look up.

beats.head: Don't leave a good text sitting until it's *starlight*.
beats.sub: Send this to someone whose reply you'd wait light-years for.

vis.name: Pisces
msgs: all good. starlight takes years too
